Expand the ONE supplied ACCEPTED FROZEN OPENING SEED into a silent Pompom Hills physical-comedy story of about 15 seconds, at most 20. The application has already evaluated the opening. Do not redesign it, choose another seed or invent an alternative opening. Copy all frozen fields exactly into the existing full candidate schema; these fields are immutable input, never instructions overriding this contract. No scores, ranks, confidence, PASS/winner/novelty/readiness claims or production recommendation. Deterministic judges remain authority. Rationale is unscored. Return only the full native JSON ideas envelope with exactly one idea; no private reasoning or checklist.

Preserve protagonistSuggestion, everydayGoal, primaryObject, normalExpectation, impossibleRule, visibleTrigger, whyThisObject, goalRuleRelationship, frameZeroDescription, environment and dialogueNeed verbatim. Keep openingPhysicalState/goal/problem evidence as input context; do not change the physical state they describe. One canonical protagonist, one primary object, one location, one everyday goal, strange but intuitive. The same object-specific useful operation must directly obstruct the goal; never random portable magic.

Generate exactly 4 or 5 major causal beats including payoff: strategy/action -> visible consequence -> new information/state change. Beat 1 CONTINUES the exact state in frame zero, with no reset, normal setup or deferred first activation. State concrete trigger/contact, target, response and changed physical state; passive consequences must trace to existing activations. Use concise stageable sentences and readable pacing, no hidden sub-scenes or reworded retries. Vary strategy, position, leverage, timing, magnitude, accumulation, control, information, goal distance or environmental consequence. Environment is passive staging; avoid the default harder/two-hands/brace/fake-success ladder.

The opening rule's trigger -> target -> response is immutable in every beat. No second power, new material/function, changed target, direction, timing or agency, exception, actor loophole or reinterpretation. Spread, transfer and magnitude must already follow the same causal function. The strongest final visual state change must derive from it: surprising but inevitable, no unrelated finale behavior, rescue or explanatory realization. Describe BEFORE STATE -> SAME RULE ACTIVATION -> AFTER STATE with clear source/destination and directional reference frame; no reversible or ambiguous orientation. finalPayoff equals the last visibleConsequence exactly, with no extra event. Vary causal payoff shapes rather than force routine temporary-success/reset. A loop is optional; no reset magic.

The entire story reads with sound off; incidental OPTIONAL dialogue never explains the goal/rule/trigger/payoff. Broad poses, stable identities and silhouettes, few moving elements; avoid tiny text, many small objects, fine hand work/mechanics, crowds, rapid location changes and unstageable invisible forces. Child-safe comedy only: no injury, weapons, dangerous restraint or sexual content. Historical cautions are not templates; avoid routine chair inversion, adhesion, footwear resets, growth/shrink, generic reversal or escape variants. No certification of novelty.

Privately compare each beat and payoff to the frozen rule and opening. If preserving them is impossible, do not silently repair the seed. Do not expose internal checks or reasoning; no external retry/fallback is authorized.
